attributes.workflow_criticism: Measured defects in this work order itself. (i) Item 1 says the repair 'MOVES FIVE LAWS' EVIDENCE SCORES'; it moves SIX. The count came from the CX record's own sentence, which splits class B into `seven versionless ids in laws_applied` plus `the eighth is a DATE typo` and never says the eighth is ALSO in laws_applied. It is. A record that quotes a field name for one subset and not the other invites exactly this undercount, and the order inherited it verbatim -- the dispatch rule that a number needs a record id was satisfied, and the number was still wrong. (ii) Item 9 states the observation BACKWARDS: `fndiff.objdump raises on missing flags instead of returning ''`. It returned '' and raised nothing; that IS the defect and the item names the fix as the symptom. Reproducing before designing is what caught it, which is the run-50 lesson the order itself cites. (iii) Item 5 bundles four unrelated observations under one heading, two of which do not reproduce at HEAD (`name: None`, the cross-TU pin attribution) -- the second was already fixed by the very `_tu_matches_pin_unit` boundary rule whose comment names the anim/anim_play pair. An order item is the unit of reproduction; four observations in one item cost four reproductions to discover that two were already deliverables. (iv) Item 2's parenthetical cure ('when genuine rows RISE or the region holds unpaired clusters') smuggles the untested discriminant AGENTS.md's own dispatch rule forbids, and calibration refuted the second half of it at 87.6%. (v) NO item carried the reporter's verbatim command output, only paraphrases; every one had to be re-derived from the cited records, which DID carry it. The dispatch rule ('the MEASUREMENT belongs to the reporter -- quote the failing command and its verbatim output, not a paraphrase') is written and was not followed. TOOL friction, separately: `gdlmem.py <sub> --help` is the natural way to find a flag and it crashed on the one subcommand that matters most; `propose-record` refuses `workflow:` subjects that the template itself advertises, because the catalog has no matching row.

hypothesis.statement: TWO ITEMS FOR THE NEXT TOOL LANE, both cheap and both measured here. (1) `validate`'s dangling_citations is truncated by a literal `[:60]` slice while dangling_citation_count is the untruncated length, so the debt cannot be enumerated from validate's own output; make the list complete (or paginated with a stated cap) and report the FIVE CLASSES CX identified rather than one number -- 59 remain and 88% of them are structural or historical by that classification. (2) The class-B repair mechanism generalises: `complete_law_citations` already completes versionless ids for NEW proposals at propose time, and the ACCEPTED corpus was never swept with it. Zero versionless ids remain after this run, so the sweep is a REGRESSION GUARD, not a cleanup -- a test that walks records/** and asserts no laws_applied entry lacks a version suffix would keep it at zero for free.
